newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Tai Lim sets 1-for-5 rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Tai Lim sets 1-for-5 rights offer.

text.p: South Korea's Tai Lim Packaging Industrial Co Ltd said on Thursday it would offer a one-for-five rights issue in February to raise operating funds.
The issue will increase paid-in capital to 19.83 billion won from about 15.83 billion at present.

Tai Lim said in a statement that it plans to issue 800,000 new common shares, of which 20 percent would be offered to its employees. The rest will be allocated to shareholders registered as of December 31.
The issue price will be set at a 20 percent discount to the base price, which will be decided later.
Subscription is scheduled for February 4 and 5, with payment due by February 19.
Tai Lim shares closed on Thursday 1,000 won higher at 21,500.
